_maxConcurrent: One prompt at a time, across everything this machine runs, to keep the load on one GPU. Raise it (or set 0 for no limit) on a batching server such as vLLM on the DGX. LLM_MAX_CONCURRENT overrides it.
_comment: LM Studio's local server. Start it from the Developer tab and load the model named above. Ollama instead? baseUrl http://localhost:11434/v1 and the model as Ollama names it, e.g. qwen2.5:7b-instruct. An environment variable still overrides anything here, so one run can point somewhere else without editing this file.
